# ============================================
# Cell 4 — RAM এ Data Load
# ============================================

IMG_SIZE = 256

print(f"📦 {len(train_images) + len(test_images)} images RAM এ load হচ্ছে...")
print("-" * 50)

def load_data(image_paths, mask_paths, split_name):
    imgs, msks = [], []
    for i, (img_path, mask_path) in enumerate(zip(image_paths, mask_paths)):
        img  = cv2.imread(img_path)
        img  = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
        img  = cv2.resize(img, (IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE))
        img  = img.astype(np.float32) / 255.0

        mask = cv2.imread(mask_path, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
        mask = cv2.resize(mask, (IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE))
        mask = (mask > 127).astype(np.float32)

        imgs.append(img)
        msks.append(mask)

        if i % 500 == 0:
            ram = psutil.virtual_memory()
            print(f"  [{split_name}] {i}/{len(image_paths)} | RAM: {ram.used/1024**3:.1f}/{ram.total/1024**3:.1f} GB")

    imgs = torch.tensor(np.array(imgs)).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
    msks = torch.tensor(np.array(msks)).unsqueeze(1)
    return imgs, msks

# Load
train_imgs_tensor, train_msks_tensor = load_data(train_images, train_masks, "Train")
test_imgs_tensor,  test_msks_tensor  = load_data(test_images,  test_masks,  "Test")

print("-" * 50)
print(f"✅ Load শেষ!")
print(f"   Train : {train_imgs_tensor.shape} | {train_imgs_tensor.nbytes/1024**3:.2f} GB")
print(f"   Test  : {test_imgs_tensor.shape}  | {test_imgs_tensor.nbytes/1024**3:.2f} GB")

# ============================================
# Cell 6 — ResU-Net Architecture
# ============================================

class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(out_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch)
        )
        self.skip = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch)
        )
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.relu(self.conv(x) + self.skip(x))


class ResUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels=3, out_channels=1):
        super().__init__()
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = ResBlock(in_channels, 64)
        self.enc2 = ResBlock(64, 128)
        self.enc3 = ResBlock(128, 256)
        self.enc4 = ResBlock(256, 512)
        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = ResBlock(512, 1024)
        # Decoder
        self.up4  = nn.ConvTranspose2d(1024, 512, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec4 = ResBlock(1024, 512)
        self.up3  = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = ResBlock(512, 256)
        self.up2  = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = ResBlock(256, 128)
        self.up1  = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = ResBlock(128, 64)
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, out_channels, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool(e2))
        e4 = self.enc4(self.pool(e3))
        b  = self.bottleneck(self.pool(e4))
        d4 = self.dec4(torch.cat([self.up4(b),  e4], dim=1))
        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([self.up3(d4), e3], dim=1))
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([self.up2(d3), e2], dim=1))
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([self.up1(d2), e1], dim=1))
        return self.final(d1)


model = ResUNet(in_channels=3).to(device)
total_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
print(f"✅ ResU-Net তৈরি হয়েছে!")
print(f"   Parameters: {total_params:,}")

# ============================================
# Cell 7 — Training (FP16 + GPU Optimized)
# ============================================

class DiceBCELoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.bce = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        bce   = self.bce(pred, target)
        pred  = torch.sigmoid(pred)
        inter = (pred * target).sum(dim=(2, 3))
        dice  = 1 - (2*inter + 1) / (pred.sum(dim=(2,3)) + target.sum(dim=(2,3)) + 1)
        return bce + dice.mean()

def dice_score(pred, target, threshold=0.5):
    pred  = (torch.sigmoid(pred) > threshold).float()
    inter = (pred * target).sum(dim=(2, 3))
    return ((2*inter + 1) / (pred.sum(dim=(2,3)) + target.sum(dim=(2,3)) + 1)).mean().item()


criterion = DiceBCELoss()
optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3)
scheduler = ReduceLROnPlateau(optimizer, mode='max', patience=3, factor=0.5)
scaler    = torch.amp.GradScaler('cuda')  # ✅ Fixed

EPOCHS    = 30
history   = {'train_loss':[], 'val_loss':[], 'train_dice':[], 'val_dice':[]}
best_dice = 0

print("🚀 ResU-Net Training শুরু হচ্ছে!")
print("=" * 70)

for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    # Training
    model.train()
    train_loss, train_dice_sum = 0, 0

    for images, masks in train_loader:
        images, masks = images.to(device), masks.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with torch.amp.autocast('cuda'):  # ✅ Fixed
            output = model(images)
            loss   = criterion(output, masks)
        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        train_loss     += loss.item()
        train_dice_sum += dice_score(output, masks)

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    val_loss, val_dice_sum = 0, 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for images, masks in val_loader:
            images, masks = images.to(device), masks.to(device)
            with torch.amp.autocast('cuda'):  # ✅ Fixed
                output = model(images)
                loss   = criterion(output, masks)
            val_loss     += loss.item()
            val_dice_sum += dice_score(output, masks)

    t_loss = train_loss     / len(train_loader)
    v_loss = val_loss       / len(val_loader)
    t_dice = train_dice_sum / len(train_loader)
    v_dice = val_dice_sum   / len(val_loader)

    history['train_loss'].append(t_loss)
    history['val_loss'].append(v_loss)
    history['train_dice'].append(t_dice)
    history['val_dice'].append(v_dice)

    scheduler.step(v_dice)

    if v_dice > best_dice:
        best_dice = v_dice
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), 'resunet_brisc_best.pth')
        print(f"  💾 Best model saved! Dice: {v_dice:.4f}")

    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS} | "
          f"Loss: {t_loss:.4f}/{v_loss:.4f} | "
          f"Dice: {t_dice:.4f}/{v_dice:.4f}")

print(f"\n🏆 ResU-Net Best Val Dice: {best_dice*100:.2f}%")

# ============================================
# Cell 9 — Attention U-Net Architecture
# ============================================

class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, F_g, F_l, F_int):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_g = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_g, F_int, 1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int)
        )
        self.W_x = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_l, F_int, 1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int)
        )
        self.psi = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_int, 1, 1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(1),
            nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        g1  = self.W_g(g)
        x1  = self.W_x(x)
        psi = self.relu(g1 + x1)
        psi = self.psi(psi)
        return x * psi


class ConvBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(out_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.conv(x)


class AttentionUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels=3, out_channels=1):
        super().__init__()
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = ConvBlock(in_channels, 64)
        self.enc2 = ConvBlock(64, 128)
        self.enc3 = ConvBlock(128, 256)
        self.enc4 = ConvBlock(256, 512)
        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = ConvBlock(512, 1024)
        # Attention + Decoder
        self.att4  = AttentionBlock(512, 512, 256)
        self.up4   = nn.ConvTranspose2d(1024, 512, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec4  = ConvBlock(1024, 512)

        self.att3  = AttentionBlock(256, 256, 128)
        self.up3   = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3  = ConvBlock(512, 256)

        self.att2  = AttentionBlock(128, 128, 64)
        self.up2   = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2  = ConvBlock(256, 128)

        self.att1  = AttentionBlock(64, 64, 32)
        self.up1   = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1  = ConvBlock(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, out_channels, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool(e2))
        e4 = self.enc4(self.pool(e3))
        b  = self.bottleneck(self.pool(e4))

        d4 = self.dec4(torch.cat([self.up4(b),  self.att4(self.up4(b), e4)], dim=1))
        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([self.up3(d4), self.att3(self.up3(d4), e3)], dim=1))
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([self.up2(d3), self.att2(self.up2(d3), e2)], dim=1))
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([self.up1(d2), self.att1(self.up1(d2), e1)], dim=1))
        return self.final(d1)


model = AttentionUNet(in_channels=3).to(device)
total_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
print(f"✅ Attention U-Net তৈরি হয়েছে!")
print(f"   Parameters: {total_params:,}")

            output = model(images)
            loss   = criterion(output, masks)
        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        train_loss     += loss.item()
        train_dice_sum += dice_score(output, masks)

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    val_loss, val_dice_sum = 0, 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for images, masks in val_loader:
            images, masks = images.to(device), masks.to(device)
            with torch.amp.autocast('cuda'):
                output = model(images)
                loss   = criterion(output, masks)
            val_loss     += loss.item()
            val_dice_sum += dice_score(output, masks)

    t_loss = train_loss     / len(train_loader)
    v_loss = val_loss       / len(val_loader)
    t_dice = train_dice_sum / len(train_loader)
    v_dice = val_dice_sum   / len(val_loader)

    history_att['train_loss'].append(t_loss)
    history_att['val_loss'].append(v_loss)
    history_att['train_dice'].append(t_dice)
    history_att['val_dice'].append(v_dice)

    scheduler.step(v_dice)

    if v_dice > best_dice:
        best_dice = v_dice
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), 'att_unet_brisc_best.pth')
        print(f"  💾 Best model saved! Dice: {v_dice:.4f}")

    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS} | "
          f"Loss: {t_loss:.4f}/{v_loss:.4f} | "
          f"Dice: {t_dice:.4f}/{v_dice:.4f}")

print(f"\n🏆 Attention U-Net Best Val Dice: {best_dice*100:.2f}%")

# ============================================
# Cell 12 — U-Net++ Architecture
# ============================================

class ConvBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(out_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.conv(x)


class UNetPlusPlus(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels=3, out_channels=1):
        super().__init__()
        nb_filter = [32, 64, 128, 256, 512]

        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Encoder
        self.enc0_0 = ConvBlock(in_channels,   nb_filter[0])
        self.enc1_0 = ConvBlock(nb_filter[0],  nb_filter[1])
        self.enc2_0 = ConvBlock(nb_filter[1],  nb_filter[2])
        self.enc3_0 = ConvBlock(nb_filter[2],  nb_filter[3])
        self.enc4_0 = ConvBlock(nb_filter[3],  nb_filter[4])

        # Dense connections — Level 1
        self.up0_1   = nn.ConvTranspose2d(nb_filter[1], nb_filter[0], 2, stride=2)
        self.conv0_1 = ConvBlock(nb_filter[0]*2, nb_filter[0])

        self.up1_1   = nn.ConvTranspose2d(nb_filter[2], nb_filter[1], 2, stride=2)
        self.conv1_1 = ConvBlock(nb_filter[1]*2, nb_filter[1])

        self.up2_1   = nn.ConvTranspose2d(nb_filter[3], nb_filter[2], 2, stride=2)
        self.conv2_1 = ConvBlock(nb_filter[2]*2, nb_filter[2])

        self.up3_1   = nn.ConvTranspose2d(nb_filter[4], nb_filter[3], 2, stride=2)
        self.conv3_1 = ConvBlock(nb_filter[3]*2, nb_filter[3])

        # Dense connections — Level 2
        self.up0_2   = nn.ConvTranspose2d(nb_filter[1], nb_filter[0], 2, stride=2)
        self.conv0_2 = ConvBlock(nb_filter[0]*3, nb_filter[0])

        self.up1_2   = nn.ConvTranspose2d(nb_filter[2], nb_filter[1], 2, stride=2)
        self.conv1_2 = ConvBlock(nb_filter[1]*3, nb_filter[1])

        self.up2_2   = nn.ConvTranspose2d(nb_filter[3], nb_filter[2], 2, stride=2)
        self.conv2_2 = ConvBlock(nb_filter[2]*3, nb_filter[2])

        # Dense connections — Level 3
        self.up0_3   = nn.ConvTranspose2d(nb_filter[1], nb_filter[0], 2, stride=2)
        self.conv0_3 = ConvBlock(nb_filter[0]*4, nb_filter[0])

        self.up1_3   = nn.ConvTranspose2d(nb_filter[2], nb_filter[1], 2, stride=2)
        self.conv1_3 = ConvBlock(nb_filter[1]*4, nb_filter[1])

        # Dense connections — Level 4
        self.up0_4   = nn.ConvTranspose2d(nb_filter[1], nb_filter[0], 2, stride=2)
        self.conv0_4 = ConvBlock(nb_filter[0]*5, nb_filter[0])

        self.final   = nn.Conv2d(nb_filter[0], out_channels, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        x0_0 = self.enc0_0(x)
        x1_0 = self.enc1_0(self.pool(x0_0))
        x2_0 = self.enc2_0(self.pool(x1_0))
        x3_0 = self.enc3_0(self.pool(x2_0))
        x4_0 = self.enc4_0(self.pool(x3_0))

        # Level 1
        x0_1 = self.conv0_1(torch.cat([x0_0, self.up0_1(x1_0)], dim=1))
        x1_1 = self.conv1_1(torch.cat([x1_0, self.up1_1(x2_0)], dim=1))
        x2_1 = self.conv2_1(torch.cat([x2_0, self.up2_1(x3_0)], dim=1))
        x3_1 = self.conv3_1(torch.cat([x3_0, self.up3_1(x4_0)], dim=1))

        # Level 2
        x0_2 = self.conv0_2(torch.cat([x0_0, x0_1, self.up0_2(x1_1)], dim=1))
        x1_2 = self.conv1_2(torch.cat([x1_0, x1_1, self.up1_2(x2_1)], dim=1))
        x2_2 = self.conv2_2(torch.cat([x2_0, x2_1, self.up2_2(x3_1)], dim=1))

        # Level 3
        x0_3 = self.conv0_3(torch.cat([x0_0, x0_1, x0_2, self.up0_3(x1_2)], dim=1))
        x1_3 = self.conv1_3(torch.cat([x1_0, x1_1, x1_2, self.up1_3(x2_2)], dim=1))

        # Level 4
        x0_4 = self.conv0_4(torch.cat([x0_0, x0_1, x0_2, x0_3, self.up0_4(x1_3)], dim=1))

        return self.final(x0_4)


model = UNetPlusPlus(in_channels=3).to(device)
total_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
print(f"✅ U-Net++ তৈরি হয়েছে!")
print(f"   Parameters: {total_params:,}")

    train_loss, train_dice_sum = 0, 0

    for images, masks in train_loader:
        images, masks = images.to(device), masks.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with torch.amp.autocast('cuda'):
            output = model(images)
            loss   = criterion(output, masks)
        scaler.scale(loss).backward()

        scaler.update()
        train_loss     += loss.item()
        train_dice_sum += dice_score(output, masks)

    # Validation

    val_loss, val_dice_sum = 0, 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for images, masks in val_loader:
            images, masks = images.to(device), masks.to(device)
            with torch.amp.autocast('cuda'):
                output = model(images)
                loss   = criterion(output, masks)
            val_loss     += loss.item()
            val_dice_sum += dice_score(output, masks)

    t_loss = train_loss     / len(train_loader)
    v_loss = val_loss       / len(val_loader)

    scheduler.step(v_dice)

    if v_dice > best_dice:

    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS} | "

# ============================================
# Cell 16 — Augmentation + DataLoader
# ============================================

import random

class AugmentedDataset(torch.utils.data.Dataset):
    def __init__(self, images, masks, augment=True):
        self.images  = images
        self.masks   = masks
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.images)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        image = self.images[idx].clone()
        mask  = self.masks[idx].clone()

        if self.augment:
            # ১. Horizontal Flip
            if random.random() > 0.5:
                image = torch.flip(image, dims=[2])
                mask  = torch.flip(mask,  dims=[2])

            # ২. Vertical Flip
            if random.random() > 0.5:
                image = torch.flip(image, dims=[1])
                mask  = torch.flip(mask,  dims=[1])

            # ৩. Brightness
            if random.random() > 0.5:
                factor = random.uniform(0.8, 1.2)
                image  = torch.clamp(image * factor, 0, 1)

            # ৪. Rotation (90, 180, 270)
            if random.random() > 0.5:
                k     = random.choice([1, 2, 3])
                image = torch.rot90(image, k, dims=[1, 2])
                mask  = torch.rot90(mask,  k, dims=[1, 2])

        return image, mask


# Dataset তৈরি
train_size = int(0.8 * len(train_imgs_tensor))
val_size   = len(train_imgs_tensor) - train_size

indices        = torch.randperm(len(train_imgs_tensor))
train_indices  = indices[:train_size]
val_indices    = indices[train_size:]

train_aug_dataset = AugmentedDataset(
    train_imgs_tensor[train_indices],
    train_msks_tensor[train_indices],
    augment=True   # Train এ augmentation ON
)
val_aug_dataset = AugmentedDataset(
    train_imgs_tensor[val_indices],
    train_msks_tensor[val_indices],
    augment=False  # Val এ augmentation OFF
)

train_loader_aug = DataLoader(train_aug_dataset, batch_size=16,
                              shuffle=True,  num_workers=0, pin_memory=True)
val_loader_aug   = DataLoader(val_aug_dataset,   batch_size=16,
                              shuffle=False, num_workers=0, pin_memory=True)

print(f"✅ Augmented DataLoader তৈরি হয়েছে!")
print(f"   Train : {train_size} images | {len(train_loader_aug)} batches")
print(f"   Val   : {val_size}  images | {len(val_loader_aug)} batches")
print(f"   Augmentations: Flip + Brightness + Rotation ✅")

# ============================================
# Cell 17 — Pretrained Encoder দিয়ে ResU-Net
# ============================================

import torchvision.models as models

class PretrainedResUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, out_channels=1):
        super().__init__()

        # Pretrained ResNet34 — Encoder হিসেবে ব্যবহার করব
        resnet = models.resnet34(weights='IMAGENET1K_V1')

        # Encoder — ResNet34 এর layers
        self.enc0 = nn.Sequential(resnet.conv1, resnet.bn1, resnet.relu)  # 64ch
        self.pool = resnet.maxpool
        self.enc1 = resnet.layer1  # 64ch
        self.enc2 = resnet.layer2  # 128ch
        self.enc3 = resnet.layer3  # 256ch
        self.enc4 = resnet.layer4  # 512ch

        # Decoder
        self.up4  = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec4 = ResBlock(512, 256)

        self.up3  = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = ResBlock(256, 128)

        self.up2  = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = ResBlock(128, 64)

        self.up1  = nn.ConvTranspose2d(64, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = ResBlock(128, 64)

        self.up0  = nn.ConvTranspose2d(64, 32, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec0 = ResBlock(32, 32)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(32, out_channels, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e0 = self.enc0(x)       # (64, H/2, W/2)
        e1 = self.enc1(self.pool(e0))  # (64, H/4, W/4)
        e2 = self.enc2(e1)      # (128, H/8, W/8)
        e3 = self.enc3(e2)      # (256, H/16, W/16)
        e4 = self.enc4(e3)      # (512, H/32, W/32)

        # Decoder
        d4 = self.dec4(torch.cat([self.up4(e4), e3], dim=1))
        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([self.up3(d4), e2], dim=1))
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([self.up2(d3), e1], dim=1))
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([self.up1(d2), e0], dim=1))
        d0 = self.dec0(self.up0(d1))

        return self.final(d0)


model = PretrainedResUNet().to(device)
total_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
print(f"✅ Pretrained ResU-Net তৈরি হয়েছে!")
print(f"   Parameters: {total_params:,}")
print(f"   Encoder: ResNet34 (ImageNet pretrained) ✅")
print(f"   Augmentation: ON ✅")

# Cell 18 — Pretrained ResU-Net Training
# ============================================

criterion = DiceBCELoss()
optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=1e-4)  # Fine-tuning এ lr ছোট
scheduler = ReduceLROnPlateau(optimizer, mode='max', patience=3, factor=0.5)
scaler    = torch.amp.GradScaler('cuda')

EPOCHS       = 30
history_pre  = {'train_loss':[], 'val_loss':[], 'train_dice':[], 'val_dice':[]}
best_dice    = 0

print("🚀 Pretrained ResU-Net Training শুরু হচ্ছে!")
print("   Augmentation : ON ✅")
print("   Fine-Tuning  : ON ✅")
print("=" * 70)

for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    # Training
    model.train()
    train_loss, train_dice_sum = 0, 0

    for images, masks in train_loader_aug:
        images, masks = images.to(device), masks.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with torch.amp.autocast('cuda'):
            output = model(images)
            loss   = criterion(output, masks)
        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        train_loss     += loss.item()
        train_dice_sum += dice_score(output, masks)

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    val_loss, val_dice_sum = 0, 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for images, masks in val_loader_aug:
            images, masks = images.to(device), masks.to(device)
            with torch.amp.autocast('cuda'):
                output = model(images)
                loss   = criterion(output, masks)
            val_loss     += loss.item()
            val_dice_sum += dice_score(output, masks)

    t_loss = train_loss     / len(train_loader_aug)
    v_loss = val_loss       / len(val_loader_aug)
    t_dice = train_dice_sum / len(train_loader_aug)
    v_dice = val_dice_sum   / len(val_loader_aug)

    history_pre['train_loss'].append(t_loss)
    history_pre['val_loss'].append(v_loss)
    history_pre['train_dice'].append(t_dice)
    history_pre['val_dice'].append(v_dice)

    scheduler.step(v_dice)

    if v_dice > best_dice:
        best_dice = v_dice
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), 'pretrained_resunet_best.pth')
        print(f"  💾 Best model saved! Dice: {v_dice:.4f}")

    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS} | "
          f"Loss: {t_loss:.4f}/{v_loss:.4f} | "
          f"Dice: {t_dice:.4f}/{v_dice:.4f}")

print(f"\n🏆 Pretrained ResU-Net Best Val Dice: {best_dice*100:.2f}%")

# ============================================
# Cell 22 — DeepLabV3+ Model
# ============================================

import torchvision.models.segmentation as seg_models

class DeepLabV3Plus(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, out_channels=1):
        super().__init__()
        # Pretrained DeepLabV3+ with ResNet50 backbone
        self.model = seg_models.deeplabv3_resnet50(
            weights='DEFAULT'
        )
        # Last layer বদলাও — binary segmentation এর জন্য
        self.model.classifier[4] = nn.Conv2d(256, out_channels, 1)
        self.model.aux_classifier[4] = nn.Conv2d(256, out_channels, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        output = self.model(x)['out']
        return output


model = DeepLabV3Plus().to(device)
total_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
print(f"✅ DeepLabV3+ তৈরি হয়েছে!")
print(f"   Parameters : {total_params:,}")

print(f"   Augmentation: ON ✅")

# ============================================
# Sample Predictions — Best Model
# ============================================

import torchvision.models as tv_models
import torch.nn.functional as F

class PretrainedResUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, out_channels=1):
        super().__init__()
        resnet = tv_models.resnet34(weights='IMAGENET1K_V1')  # ← tv_models

        self.enc0 = nn.Sequential(resnet.conv1, resnet.bn1, resnet.relu)
        self.pool = resnet.maxpool
        self.enc1 = resnet.layer1
        self.enc2 = resnet.layer2
        self.enc3 = resnet.layer3
        self.enc4 = resnet.layer4

        self.up4  = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec4 = ResBlock(512, 256)
        self.up3  = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = ResBlock(256, 128)
        self.up2  = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = ResBlock(128, 64)
        self.up1  = nn.ConvTranspose2d(64, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = ResBlock(128, 64)
        self.up0  = nn.ConvTranspose2d(64, 32, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec0 = ResBlock(32, 32)
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(32, out_channels, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        e0 = self.enc0(x)
        e1 = self.enc1(self.pool(e0))
        e2 = self.enc2(e1)
        e3 = self.enc3(e2)
        e4 = self.enc4(e3)
        d4 = self.dec4(torch.cat([self.up4(e4), e3], dim=1))
        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([self.up3(d4), e2], dim=1))
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([self.up2(d3), e1], dim=1))
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([self.up1(d2), e0], dim=1))
        d0 = self.dec0(self.up0(d1))
        return self.final(d0)

# Best model load করো
best_model = PretrainedResUNet().to(device)
best_model.load_state_dict(torch.load('pretrained_resunet_best.pth'))
best_model.eval()

# Test data থেকে sample নাও
sample_images = test_imgs_tensor[:5].to(device)
sample_masks  = test_msks_tensor[:5]

with torch.no_grad():
    preds = torch.sigmoid(best_model(sample_images)).cpu()

fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 5, figsize=(18, 10))
fig.suptitle('Pretrained ResU-Net — Sample Predictions (Best Model: 88.52%)', fontsize=14)

for i in range(5):
    axes[0, i].imshow(sample_images[i].cpu().permute(1,2,0))
    axes[0, i].set_title('MRI Image')
    axes[0, i].axis('off')

    axes[1, i].imshow(sample_masks[i].squeeze(), cmap='gray')
    axes[1, i].set_title('Ground Truth')
    axes[1, i].axis('off')

    axes[2, i].imshow((preds[i].squeeze() > 0.5), cmap='gray')
    axes[2, i].set_title('Predicted')
    axes[2, i].axis('off')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('segmentation_predictions.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()
print("✅ Sample Predictions সংরক্ষিত হয়েছে!")
